svg.title: 4C open-source Harness ladder for interactive coding
svg.desc: Fifteen active open-source coding Harnesses answer the same frozen source exam. DeepSeek Harness leads at 86. Longer bars mean better fit, not higher cost.
svg.text: Candidate-blind exam · 12 frozen questions · Exact commits · Missing evidence scores zero

g.text: SOURCE EXAM LEADER · FIXED TEST V2
LONGER BAR = MORE VERIFIED OUTPUT PER LIMIT. COST EFFICIENCY IS BETTER WHEN LONGER.
SCOPE Active general-purpose open-source coding Harnesses with ≥10k GitHub stars
EXAM 12 frozen questions · 0 / HALF / FULL · No candidate-specific weights · Missing evidence = 0
BOUNDARY Source examination only. Paired runtime trials may overturn this order. Contract hash pins the test.
